info.title: Barbershop Handler API
info.description:
REST API for the Barbershop management platform. Supports three portals: **Admin** (shop management), **Barber** (personal dashboard), and **Client** (booking). 

## Authentication
- **Admin**: `POST /api/auth/login` → sets `session_id` cookie (7 days)
- **Barber**: `POST /api/barbers/login` → sets `barber_session_id` + `barber_id` cookies (7 days)
- **Client**: `POST /api/users/login` → sets `user_session_id` + `user_id` cookies (30 days)
- **Guest booking**: No auth required — use `POST /api/book`

## Response format
All endpoints return a unified JSON envelope:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": {...}, "message": "optional" }
{ "success": false, "error": "description" }
```

post.description: Authenticates the admin with username + password. On success, sets a `session_id` HTTP-only cookie valid for 7 days.

get.description: Returns whether the current request has a valid admin session cookie.

post.description: Authenticates a barber by email + password. Sets `barber_session_id` and `barber_id` HTTP-only cookies (7 days).

200.description: Login successful — `barber_session_id` and `barber_id` cookies are set

post.description: Authenticates a registered client. Sets `user_session_id` and `user_id` HTTP-only cookies (30 days). Password is excluded from the response.
Creates a new client user account. Validates email format and password confirmation.

get.description: Returns all barbers. Pass `?id=` to fetch a single barber by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of a specific barber

200.description: List of barbers (or a single barber when `id` is provided)

post.description: Creates a new barber account. Requires admin session.

patch.description: Partially updates a barber record. `_id` must be included in the request body.

delete.description: Sets `isActive = false` on the barber. Does not permanently delete the record.

put.description: Full profile update for a barber by path param ID. Fields `_id`, `password`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` are ignored. Used by the barber profile page.

post.description: Validates the current password with bcrypt before setting the new one.

get.description:
Flexible query endpoint. Behaviour depends on which query params are provided:
- `availability=1 + barberId + date` → returns available time slots (ISO intervals)
- `date` only → all non-cancelled appointments for that day
- `barberId` → appointments for that barber (with optional date range)
- No special params → all appointments with optional `status`, `startDate`, `endDate` filters

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Fetch appointments or availability for a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Set to any truthy value together with `barberId` and `date` to get free time slots

post.description: Creates a new appointment. Checks for time conflicts on the selected barber before saving.

patch.description: Partially updates an appointment. `_id` must be included in the body.

delete.description:
- `action=complete` → sets status `completed` + paymentStatus `paid`
- `action=cancel` (default) → sets status `cancelled` + paymentStatus `refunded`

post.description: Creates an appointment without requiring any account or authentication. Used by the public booking wizard at `/client/book`. `endTime` is computed server-side from `startTime + duration`.

get.description: Returns all barbers with `isActive = true`. No authentication required. Used in the public booking wizard.

get.summary: Available time slots for a barber
get.description: Returns 30-minute slots that are not yet booked for the given barber on the given date. Respects the barber's working hours and skips past slots. Returns empty array if the barber is closed that day.

get.summary: Get appointments for a client user

post.description: Creates an appointment linked to a client account. Also updates the user's appointments list.

delete.description: Sets appointment status to `cancelled` and removes it from the user's list.

get.description:
Returns different datasets depending on query params:
- `report=YYYY-MM-DD` → daily report for that date
- `barber={id}` (+ optional `daysRange`) → barber-specific dashboard (last N days, default 30)
- No params → today's global shop statistics

parameters.name: daysRange
parameters.description: Number of past days to include (used with `barber`)

get.description:
Flexible query. Special modes:
- `byCategory=1` → totals grouped by category (for the given date range, default last 30 days)
- `dailyTotals=1` → daily income/expense totals (for the given date range)
- Default → list of transactions with optional filters

patch.description: `_id` must be included in the body.

get.description: Returns all registered client users. Passwords are excluded. Requires admin session.

post.description: Creates a new client user account. Minimum password length: 6 characters.

get.description: Returns all inventory items. Pass `?lowStock=1` to return only items where `quantity <= minQuantity`.

patch.description: `_id` must be included in the body along with the fields to update.

SlotHHMM.description: 30-minute booking slot with HH:MM formatted times (from /api/users/available-slots)

DashboardStats.description: Global today stats returned when no query params are provided

BarberDashboard.description: Barber-specific dashboard returned when `barber` query param is provided

DailyReport.description: Daily report returned when `report` query param is provided

BadRequest.description: Invalid input or missing required fields
